description.value: A Snug Harbour Inn is a six-room luxury oceanfront bed and breakfast perched on an 85-foot cliff in Ucluelet, surrounded by old-growth forest and dramatic Pacific coastline on the west coast of Vancouver Island. The inn sits directly on the Wild Pacific Trail with access from the end of the driveway and is a short drive from Pacific Rim National Park and Long Beach. It caters exclusively to adult guests, with a private beach, communal hot tub, and a Great Room featuring a wall of ocean-facing windows.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and detailed, fully corroborating OSM contact details (phone, address, website). No mention of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content; the property markets itself exclusively as a luxury adult-oriented romantic retreat. The online booking calendar displays only years 2017–2018, suggesting the website has not been updated in several years, raising uncertainty about current operating status.
concerns: Booking calendar on the website shows only years 2017–2018, suggesting the site has not been updated in several years; current operating status is uncertain.
